notes.title: V1.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that would mean asteroids always moved slowly and their speed didn't scale

notes.title: V1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixed a bug with the HUD on 16:10 displays

notes.title: V1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added friend leaderboards! When using friend leaderboards you'll be ranked against other players on your friends list
Fixed a bug where power ups could be ejected with too much speed
Fixed a bug where the new highscore text would not fit nicely when playing on Portuguese

notes.title: V1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Leaderboard stability improvements
A crown is now awarded to your leaderboard entry if you are #1. You know what to do!

notes.title: V1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Controller navigation has been improved
Reduced global volume by 7%
Improved audio quality and performance
Pause blur now scales properly to different resolutions
Shredder has been made quieter
Scythe Boomerang has a longer cooldown
Spin Bolt Strike has a longer cooldown
Fixed pause blur bug introduced in V1.0.2
Fixed a bug where ion thrusters could be used on Lv1 by destroying asteroids
Fixed a bug where asteroids would spawn during the continue prompt display
Fixed a bug where 2 secret achievements could be attained in boss rush

notes.title: V1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
HUD size has been reduced by 25%
Controller UI navigation has been improved
Fixed bug where leaderboard score upload may fail but report successfully
Fixed a bug where boss rush leaderboards would be displayed in reverse order
Fixed a bug where certain datalog entries would not fit

notes.title: V1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Improved default controller bindings
Improved UI navigation when using keyboard or a controller
Added glyphs for keys and Xbox One controller buttons to replace text prompts when applicable
Key/button is now displayed alongside the icon when a new ability is unlocked
Added a tutorial sequence for new players
Removed unused clutter from the key rebinder
Improved the calibration UI greatly
Loading screen has been added to the boot process
Fixed a rare bug where leaderboard download would fail
Fixed bugs relating to the leaderboard button
Fixed a bug where the back button (B on Xbox One) could not be rebinded
Fixed a bug where the pause menu would have no default button selected

notes.title: V0.9.7 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Leaderboards can now be viewed from the main menu due to popular demand
Levelling up now raises your EP regen rate by 1.5% per level instead of the former 1%

notes.title: V0.9.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where the off-screen trackers would persist on death

notes.title: V0.9.5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug with the quit overlay
Fixed a z-fighting bug in the second boss
Fixed a bug with the effects on flaming asteroids

notes.title: V0.9.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Added idle scythe movement to the final boss
Finished and improved the finale effects
Fixed a bug where the laser sparks from the first boss would not despawn in rare circumstances
Fixed a bug where the second boss could not track as well when Chronostasis was used

notes.title: V0.9.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Improved the telegraphing of Scythe Slash
Added an unlock image for hard mode
Added an unlock image for insane mode
Fixed localisation issues

notes.title: V0.9.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Increased power up rarity
Tweaked and balanced difficulty modes
Increased HP and aggression slightly for Boss#3 and Boss#4
Nerfed asteroid EP regen
EP can no longer be gained whilst using Chronostasis
Reduced the font size in the leaderboard to accommodate for 8 digit scores
Slightly increases giga laser strike probability on easy and normal mode

notes.title: V0.9.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1UPs are now more common
Starting 1UP count has now been increased on easy and normal mode to 7 and 5 respectively
Fixed a bug where Boss Rush times would be logged to the leaderboard on gameover
